title: A Main Title headline keeps its second line after a font pair and energy change
goal: On a Main Title over a 1280 by 800 recording, setting the theme to Sunset, the font pair to Editorial and the energy to Punchy leaves the headline showing only "The Long Way". The word "Home" on its second line is gone from the picture. Find out why and make every line of the headline show.
notes: Seen in Scripts/playtest/hand-work-survives-new-numbers-and-a-restyle-walk.json (Scripts/playtest.sh <it> --no-build), picture 6-title-restyled-sc.png, copied to queue/audits/2026-11-22-hand-work-6-title-restyled-sc.png. Playhead at 0:01. The headline is a word reveal (riseAndFade by word, start 105 ms, stagger 63, length 630 at Punchy), so every word should be in by 1 s. Picture 5 (Original theme, before the restyle) shows two lines, The Long Way / Home. In a 1920x1080 core probe the restyled Title frame is 1536x209 (two lines) and the model is identical with and without commit for task a-chart-or-title-keeps-what-you-set-by-hand-when, so this was there before it. Not yet checked: whether the 1280x800 layout re-measures the frame for Editorial, or whether the second line is drawn under the subtitle.
acceptance: Reproduced first in the probe: the walk below, or the same steps by hand, show the headline missing its second line
After Sunset, Editorial and Punchy, the headline shows every line of its words
A walk at Next defaults photographs the whole headline after those changes
